title: satellite-landuse-toolkit: land-use, forest-loss and surface-water analysis from free satellite data
description: A Python toolkit for land-use analysis of any area on Earth using only free, account-free satellite products (ESA WorldCover, Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC Global Surface Water, Sentinel-2 L2A, Esri Annual Land Cover). Runs locally without Earth Engine or API keys. Encodes the interpretation rules that keep such analyses defensible: tree-cover loss is never reported as remaining forest, two-date comparisons use a common valid-pixel mask, and threshold sensitivity is reported with every result.
